МР находка: МР данни за латерална луксация на пателата. Пателарният хрущял е лизиран почти изцяло, както и хрущяла по сътветстващата ставна повърхност на латералния февморален кондил. Стеснено е ретропателарното ставно пространство. Изобразуяват се малки субхондрални кисти и оток на костиня мозък в пателата и латералния феморален къндил, под увредения хрущял. Виждат се остеофити по полюсите на пателата и по кондилите на бедрената кост. МР данни за частично скъсване, най-вероятно с давност на медиалния поплитео-феморален лигамент. Този лигамент е с изтънен напечник и повишен сигнален интензитет. Вижда се мекотъканен оток около пателата. Наличие на ставен излив. МР  данни за дегенеративна промяна и лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Задният рог на менискуса е с повишен интензитет на сиганала, като в него се изобразява хиперинтензна линия с радиерен ход, съответваща на скъсване. Скъксването достига до края на менискуса, без да се визуализира оформен свободен фрагмент. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. initial_disagreements.draft_evidence:
Clinical information: 7 days post soccer injury with valgus shift. Medial collateral ligament testing positive. Medial collateral ligament tear? Partial posterior cruciate ligament tear?

Technique: Unenhanced point tender multiphase MRI of the left knee performed at 3.0 Tesla MRI scanner.

Findings:
The medial and lateral meniscus are intact.

There is a slightly increased T2 signal within the midportion of the anterior cruciate ligament. The anterior cruciate ligament as a construct is intact. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. The collateral ligaments are intact.

The extensor mechanism of the knee is unremarkable.

There is a focal avulsed, unhealed bone fragment at the inferior patellar pole. There is no focal bone marrow edema.

There is a focal area of extensive subchondral bone marrow edema in the weightbearing portion of the lateral tibial plateau with associated, nondisplaced subchondral fracture (17-9). There is a focal area of subcortical bone marrow edema at the anterolateral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and at the anteromedial aspect of the medial femoral condyle.

There is a minimal superficial chondrosis in the medial femorotibial joint compartment. There is a moderate patellofemoral chondrosis with focal superficial cartilage delamination at the medial patellar facet measuring 0.4 cm from medial to lateral.

There is mild joint effusion. There is a low volume Baker's cyst. The Infrapatellar fat pad is intact.

Conclusion:
1. Nondisplaced, subchondral fracture of the lateral tibial plateau with associated bone marrow edema. Posttraumatic contusions at the anterior aspect of the medial and lateral femoral condyles.
2. Low-grade partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. No acute injury of the medial collateral ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.
3. Previous unhealed avulsion fracture at the inferior patellar pole.
4. Moderate patellofemoral chondrosis with a focal area of cartilage delamination at the medial patellar facet.

all_changed_states.draft_evidence:
Clinical information: 7 days post soccer injury with valgus shift. Medial collateral ligament testing positive. Medial collateral ligament tear? Partial posterior cruciate ligament tear?

Technique: Unenhanced point tender multiphase MRI of the left knee performed at 3.0 Tesla MRI scanner.

Findings:
The medial and lateral meniscus are intact.

There is a slightly increased T2 signal within the midportion of the anterior cruciate ligament. The anterior cruciate ligament as a construct is intact. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. The collateral ligaments are intact.

The extensor mechanism of the knee is unremarkable.

There is a focal avulsed, unhealed bone fragment at the inferior patellar pole. There is no focal bone marrow edema.

There is a focal area of extensive subchondral bone marrow edema in the weightbearing portion of the lateral tibial plateau with associated, nondisplaced subchondral fracture (17-9). There is a focal area of subcortical bone marrow edema at the anterolateral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and at the anteromedial aspect of the medial femoral condyle.

There is a minimal superficial chondrosis in the medial femorotibial joint compartment. There is a moderate patellofemoral chondrosis with focal superficial cartilage delamination at the medial patellar facet measuring 0.4 cm from medial to lateral.

There is mild joint effusion. There is a low volume Baker's cyst. The Infrapatellar fat pad is intact.

Conclusion:
1. Nondisplaced, subchondral fracture of the lateral tibial plateau with associated bone marrow edema. Posttraumatic contusions at the anterior aspect of the medial and lateral femoral condyles.
2. Low-grade partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. No acute injury of the medial collateral ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.
3. Previous unhealed avulsion fracture at the inferior patellar pole.
4. Moderate patellofemoral chondrosis with a focal area of cartilage delamination at the medial patellar facet.

Силно дегенерирал е предният рог на медиалния менискус. Предният рог на менискуса е уголемен и с повишен интензитет на сигнала. Вижда е се и киста, сквързана с предния рог на медиалния менискус. Лателарният менискус е сравнително запазен. Ставният хрущял от латералната страна е с неравности в контурните очертания, съответстващи на локални дефекти. МР днни за остеофити по ставните краища на фемура и тибията. Изострени са интеркондиларните еминенции. Кръстните връзки са интактни. Визуализира се изрезен субхондрален костно-мозъчен едем в тибията. Вижда се чуждо тяло /ставна мишка/ в ставата. Чуждото тяло е с кръгла форма и големина 7мм, локализирано е дорзално, до ставната капсула и медиално. Голям ставен излив. Заключение: МР данни за напреднала гонартроза, по-изразена от медиалната страна на дясната колянна става. Дегенеративна промяна и руптура на медиалния менискус. Сублуксация на дясната колянна става. Чуждо тяло /ставна мишка/ в дясната колянна става. Ставен излив.

Виждат се малки остеофити по ставните краища на тибията от медиалната страна. Изострени са интрекондиларните еминенции. Наличие на малък ставен излив. МР данни за дегенеративна промяна и лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Задният рог на медиалния менискус е с висок интензитет на сигнала. В него се вижда хиперинтензна линия с кос ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Скъсването достига до края на менискуса. МР данни за тендинит и частични скъсвания на лигамента на пателата и сухожилието на м. квадрицепс феморис.  По отношение на напречника на споменатите сухожилие и лигамент, увредата е около 50% и се намира на залавните им към пателата места. Латерален менискус – без особености. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост и сигнална характеристика. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Едем на меките тъкани около коляното. Заключение: МР данни за остеохондрални лезии на медиалня феморален кондил. Медиална гонартроза. Лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус – 2а степен. Тендинит и частични скъсвания на лигамента на пателата и сухожилието на м. квадрицепс феморис. Малък ставен излив. Едеме на меките тъкани около коляното.

[BILATERAL NOTE: report filed jointly for both studies]
The two studies are being reported together.  
Faint linear intrasubstance fluid hyperintensity is noted at the posterior horns of both menisci, in keeping with age-related persistent vascularity.  
Otherwise intact menisci, cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus musculotendinous units, extensor tendons and both distal iliotibial bands.  
No skeletal abnormalities of note. 
No patellofemoral dysplasia morphology demonstrated on either side.  
Well-maintained tricompartmental articular cartilage surfaces are appreciated bilaterally, with no osteochondral lesions being demonstrated.  
No knee joint effusions are present on either side, nor are there any intra-articular loose bodies. 
No anterior fat pad impingement has been demonstrated either.  
Grossly unremarkable imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Matige opzetting van suprapatellaire recessus. Kruisbanden en laterale banden intact. Normaal voorkomen menisci. Matige femoropatellaire dysplasie met trochleaire hoek geschat op 157\~graden . Inclinatie laterale facet trochlea tegenover bicondylaire plan 15\~graden, binnen de norm. Caton-index 1,15, binnen de norm: geen patella alta. Normaal voorkomen verschillende pezen. Besluit: Recente patellaluxatie . Onderliggende femoropatellaire dysplasie, bevorderende factor .

all_changed_states.draft_evidence:
FINDINGS:

There is a large knee joint effusion. There is significant soft tissue swelling surrounding the knee.

There is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. There is thickening and increased signal involving the distal posterior cruciate ligament with partial tear (approximately 50% of the fibers) of the posterior medial fibers. There is mild thickening and increased signal involving the proximal and mid aspect of the PCL.

There is complete radial tear of the posterior root of the lateral meniscus. The medial meniscus is unremarkable.

There is complete tear of the medial collateral ligament with distal avulsion of the superficial component which is retracted proximally and superficial to the pes anserine tendons compatible with a pseudoStener lesion. There is also high-grade injury involving the deep meniscal femoral and meniscal tibial component of the MCL with thickening of the posterior oblique ligament.

There is almost complete tear of the lateral collateral ligament at its femoral attachment. There are thinned out fibers that appear physically continuous. This is likely a functionally complete tear. There is also almost complete tear of the popliteus tendon as it courses around the lateral femoral condyle with significant thinning and laxity of the tendon. There is disruption of the popliteal fibular ligament. The distal biceps femoris insertion remains intact.

There is significant bone marrow edema at the posterior tibial plateau fractures. There is also bone contusion involving the anterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and minimal contusion at the medial femoral condyle.

There is an enchondroma in the distal femur.

CONCLUSION:

1. Complete tear of the ACL with a moderate grade injury of the PCL.

2. High-grade injury involving the medial collateral ligament including distal avulsion of the superficial MCL with pseudo Stener lesion.

3. High-grade tear of the lateral collateral ligament which is likely functionally complete.

4. Almost complete tear of the popliteus tendon. Injury to the popliteal fibular ligament.

5. Complete radial tear involving the posterior root of the lateral meniscus.

6. Significant bone marrow edema surrounding the known tibial plateau fracture with a bone contusion in the lateral femoral condyle.

7. large knee joint effusion.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Subluxación patelar. Meniscopatía medial.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Amputación marginal del cuerno posterior del menisco lateral.

posterior del menisco medial con segmento desplazado en "asa de balde" a la región
intercondílea. El remanente a nivel del cuerpo y cuerno posterior también presenta una rotura
horizontal oblicua contacta la superficie articular inferior de manera periférica con mínimo edema
óseo periférico del platillo tibial medial de manera reactiva.

Condropatía superficial del resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales. Úlcera condral de espesor total

espesor parcial del cartílago rotuliano de distribución difusa.
Moderado derrame articular. Quiste poplíteo con signos de rotura con líquido perifascial hacia
cefálico y caudal.
Leve aumento de señal en inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura. Tendón
rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del menisco medial con segmento desplazado en "asa de balde". Rotura del
remanente a nivel del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco medial, periférica. Discreto edema
óseo periférico del platillo tibial de manera reactiva.
Rotación marginal del cuerno posterior del menisco lateral.

superficial del resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales.
Condropatía lesiones grado 4 de la tróclea femoral. Condropatía con lesiones grado 1 y 2 de la
rótula.
Moderado derrame articular. Quiste poplíteo con signos de rotura.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal

adjudication_history.source_quote: МР находка: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. Наличе на енхондром в тибията. МР данни за костномозъчен едем в медиалните конидили на фемура и тибията и ръбови остеофити на тези кондили. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и на тибията е изтънен до липсващ от страната на медиалното тибиално плато – промени, съотвеетстващи на медиален остеоартрит. Предна кръстна връзка е проследима по цялото си протежение, лекостепенно задебелена и с повишен сигнален интензитет, както при частична мукоидна дегенерация в средна и горна трета на връзката. Задната кръстна връзка се проследява до залавните си места с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. Състояние след менискектомия на медиален менискус – задният му рог е частично отстранен, с останалата част от менискуса е експулсирана встрани. Нормално изобразяване на предния му рог. Латерален менискус – с нормален МР образ. Нормално изобразяване на колатералните лигаменти. Ретинакулуми – без особености. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на меките тъкани на лявото коляно. Заключение: МР данни за медиален остеоартрит на дясната колянна става. Суспектни данни за частична мукоидна дегенерация на предната кръстна връзка, като последната е със запазена цялост. Енхондром. Увреда на заден рог на медиален менискус – частично отстранен и експулсиран встрани. Костномозъчен едем.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Zysten an der tibialen Insertion des VKB. Flächiger Knorpelverlust an der medialen Femurcondyle mit minimalem subchondralem Ödem (Serie 4/ Image 18). Ausgedehnter Substanzverlust des Innenmeniskushinternorns und in der Pars intermedia. Gering Flüssigkeit angrenzend an das MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Zysten an der tibialen Insertion des HKB, ansonsten regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Geringe oberflächliche Irregularitäten des Knorpels an der lateralen Femurcondyle sowie fokaler bis zur subchondraler Grenzlamelle reichender Defekt am lateralen Tibiaplateau (Serie 4/ Image 24). Mukoide Degeneration des Außenmeniskusvorderhorns. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Oberflächliche chondrale Irregularitäten am Patellafirst (Serie 7/ Image 10) sowie an der lateralen und medialen Trochlea, medialseitig teils auch tiefergreifende Defekte bis > 50% (Serie 7/ Image 13). Kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Patella- und der Quadrizepssehne. Regelrechter Hoffa`scher Fettkörper.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Geringer Gelenkerguss. Regelrechtes Flow-void in den erfassten Gefäßen.

adjudication_history.source_quote:
COMPARISON:Plain films [Date].

CLINICAL HISTORY:Twisting injury 4 weeks prior. Suspected transient lateral patellar dislocation.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The medial meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. The iliotibial band is intact. Popliteus tendon insertion is intact.

No femoral trochlear dysplasia. No patellofemoral subluxation. The TT-TG distance measures 20 mm, above the upper limit of normal. The patellar retinacula are intact. Once again seen are well-corticated osseous fragments at the tibial tuberosity in keeping with chronic sequelae of remote prior Osgood-Schlatter's disease. Minimal marrow edema and tiny cysts are noted in the fragments. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Full-thickness cartilage denuding patellar apex and along the lateral patellar facet. Mild lateral femorotibial chondrosis. Preserved medial femorotibial articular cartilage.

Trace knee joint fluid. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Lateralization of the tibial tubercle, predisposing to patellofemoral maltracking/instability. No patellofemoral subluxation.
2. High-grade patellofemoral chondrosis suggesting evolving moderate patellofemoral osteoarthritis of the left knee.
3. Chronic sequelae of remote prior Osgood-Schlatter's disease, also shown previously.
4. Mild lateral femorotibial chondrosis.

En corrélation avec les radiographies du genou droit, suspicion d’un ossicule méniscal au sein de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne mesurant 7-8mm de diamètre avec déchirure radiaire transfixiante à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure de même qu’au niveau de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion significative du corps méniscal de façon associée. Ceci est nouveau dans l’intervalle. Stabilité d’une déchirure longitudinale horizontale centrée au corps du ménisque interne s’étendant légèrement aux cornes postérieures et antérieures et à la surface articulaire inférieure. 
Également dans l’intervalle, il y a progression significative des changements dégénératifs au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne avec perte transfixiante des surfaces chondrales, principalement aux surfaces portantes et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Ostéophytes marginaux modérés. 
Le ligament collatéral interne est intact sans déchirure. 
Légers changements de signal au sein de la corne antérieure du ménisque externe suggérant des changements de nature mucoïde dégénératifs. Pas de franche déchirure notée. 
Changements dégénératifs légers à modérés au compartiment fémoro-tibial externe avec atténuation/fissure chondrale partielle à la surface portante et petits ostéophytes marginaux associés. 
Le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe est intact sans déchirure. 
Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure. Petit kyste intra-osseux réactionnel sous l’insertion distale du ligament croisé postérieur. 
L’alignement patellofémoral est préservé. Changements dégénératifs modérés à sévères au compartiment patellofémoral, plus marqués le long de la facette patellaire externe et apex patellaire avec fissures chondrales transfixiantes et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Ceci a minimalement progressé dans l’intervalle. Petits ostéophytes marginaux. 
Légère tendinose à l’insertion distale du tendon du quadriceps et de façon plus diffuse au niveau du tendon patellaire. Pas de franche déchirure notée. 
Conclusion : 
Nouvelle déchirure radiale transfixiante à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure de même qu’au niveau de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion secondaire marquée du corps méniscal tel que détaillé ci-haut. FINDINGS:

Fractures:
Known mildly comminuted undisplaced avulsion fracture of the tibial tuberosity involving the distal ACL insertion, anteriorly the anterior horn root insertion of the lateral meniscus, as well as posteriorly the tibial insertion of both the posterior horn of medial and lateral menisci. The fracture involves the central portion of the medial tibial plateau articular surface anteriorly and posteriorly with articular surface collapse of 3 mm anteriorly and 5 mm posteriorly, as well as a step deformity of up to 2 mm posteriorly.
Small mildly displaced avulsion fracture of the lateral corner of lateral tibial plateau [Segond fracture].
Small mild osteochondral impaction at the anterior lateral weightbearing aspect of lateral femoral condyle.
There is associated bone marrow edema associated with these fractures.

Joint alignment:
Mild widening of the medial femorotibial joint space. Otherwise preserved articular alignment.

Degenerative changes:
None.

Bone marrow signal:
Additional small area of bone marrow edema on the medial side of medial femoral condyle without evidence of associated fracture.

Anterior cruciate ligament: The distal bony avulsion with laxity of the ACL, showing some internal high T2 signal changes compatible with additional low-grade partial ligamentous tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament: Intact with mild laxity.
Medial collateral ligament: Complete tear of the superficial portion at the mid to distal third. Moderate grade partial tear of the deep meniscal femoral and meniscal tibial components with partial meniscocapsular separation of the medial meniscal body.
Lateral collateral ligament complex: Low-grade sprain of the proximal lateral collateral ligament. The other associated structures are intact.

Medial meniscus: Mild nonspecific signal changes of the meniscal body, with evidence of small horizontal oblique tear extending to the femoral surface. No other significant tear. Bony avulsion of the posterior horn root insertion as detailed above.
Lateral meniscus: Mild nonspecific signal changes at the anterior horn compatible with low-grade tearing. Evidence of small Wrisberg rip-type longitudinal tear of the periphery of the posterior horn. Complete tear of the inferior meniscal popliteal fascicle compatible with posterior lateral corner injury. There is a bony avulsion of the anterior horn and posterior horn root insertion sites.

Extensor tendons: Normal.
Patellar retinacula: Moderate grade partial tear of the medial retinaculum.
Pes anserinus: Normal.

None.

*Comminuted mildly displaced avulsion fracture of the tibial spine with mild comminution, including the distal insertion of the ACL, the anterior horn root insertion of the lateral meniscus, and posterior horn root insertion zone of the medial and lateral menisci. *Additional low-grade tears involving the medial and lateral menisci as described.
*Moderate grade partial tear of the medial patellar retinaculum.

*Large joint effusion.

adjudication_history.source_quote:
FINDINGS:

Fractures:
Known mildly comminuted undisplaced avulsion fracture of the tibial tuberosity involving the distal ACL insertion, anteriorly the anterior horn root insertion of the lateral meniscus, as well as posteriorly the tibial insertion of both the posterior horn of medial and lateral menisci. The fracture involves the central portion of the medial tibial plateau articular surface anteriorly and posteriorly with articular surface collapse of 3 mm anteriorly and 5 mm posteriorly, as well as a step deformity of up to 2 mm posteriorly.
Small mildly displaced avulsion fracture of the lateral corner of lateral tibial plateau [Segond fracture].
Small mild osteochondral impaction at the anterior lateral weightbearing aspect of lateral femoral condyle.
There is associated bone marrow edema associated with these fractures.

Joint alignment:
Mild widening of the medial femorotibial joint space. Otherwise preserved articular alignment.

Degenerative changes:
None.

Bone marrow signal:
Additional small area of bone marrow edema on the medial side of medial femoral condyle without evidence of associated fracture.

Anterior cruciate ligament: The distal bony avulsion with laxity of the ACL, showing some internal high T2 signal changes compatible with additional low-grade partial ligamentous tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament: Intact with mild laxity.
Medial collateral ligament: Complete tear of the superficial portion at the mid to distal third. Moderate grade partial tear of the deep meniscal femoral and meniscal tibial components with partial meniscocapsular separation of the medial meniscal body.
Lateral collateral ligament complex: Low-grade sprain of the proximal lateral collateral ligament. The other associated structures are intact.

Medial meniscus: Mild nonspecific signal changes of the meniscal body, with evidence of small horizontal oblique tear extending to the femoral surface. No other significant tear. Bony avulsion of the posterior horn root insertion as detailed above.
Lateral meniscus: Mild nonspecific signal changes at the anterior horn compatible with low-grade tearing. Evidence of small Wrisberg rip-type longitudinal tear of the periphery of the posterior horn. Complete tear of the inferior meniscal popliteal fascicle compatible with posterior lateral corner injury. There is a bony avulsion of the anterior horn and posterior horn root insertion sites.

Extensor tendons: Normal.
Patellar retinacula: Moderate grade partial tear of the medial retinaculum.
Pes anserinus: Normal.

Posteromedial and posterolateral corner: Diffuse signal change and mild thickening of the distal semimembranosus tendon compatible with low to moderate grade partial tearing.
Complete tear of the inferior meniscal popliteal fascicle compatible with posterior lateral corner injury.

Joint effusion: Large joint effusion.
Baker cyst: None.

Other significant findings:
None.

CONCLUSION:
*Comminuted mildly displaced avulsion fracture of the tibial spine with mild comminution, including the distal insertion of the ACL, the anterior horn root insertion of the lateral meniscus, and posterior horn root insertion zone of the medial and lateral menisci. Intra-articular fracture extension involving the central portion of the medial tibial plateau with small gap/step as described.
*Small mildly displaced lateral corner fracture of the lateral tibial plateau [Segond fracture].
*Small osteochondral impaction fracture of the lateral corner of lateral femoral condyle.
*High-grade tear of the medial collateral ligament.
*Low-grade partial tear/sprain of the anterior cruciate ligament and lateral collateral ligament.
*Additional low-grade tears involving the medial and lateral menisci as described.
*Moderate grade partial tear of the medial patellar retinaculum.
*Posteromedial and posterolateral corner injuries as described.
*Large joint effusion.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Erhaltene Artikulation im linken Kniegelenk. Zur Voruntersuchung neu minimales subchondrales Ödem im lateralen Tibiaplateau (5/20) sowie in der lateralen Femurkondyle (5/21). Zentriert stehende Patella. Aus der Voruntersuchung bekannte großflächige vorwiegend oberflächliche, teils jedoch auch fokale tief greifende Chondropathie der Trochlea mit führend der lateralen Seite (z. B. 3/73). Zu 02/20 unverändert nur geringe oberflächliche Chondropathie femorotibial. Neu fokaler Knorpeldefekt am lateralen Tibiaplateau (5/22) sowie dorsal an der medialen Femurkondyle mit angrenzender subchondraler Zyste (6/8). Bekannter und konstanter Horizontalriss der Pars intermedia und des Hinterhorns des Innenmeniskus (3/116 oder 5/20. Außenmeniskus intakt. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband regelrecht. Und Kollateralbänder intakt minimaler Flüssigkeitssaum um das MCL, DD bei geringer Reizung (5/19). Bekannte im Verlauf gering progrediente noduläre T2 gering hypointense Läsion im medialen Rezessus (3/40 oder 7/13), aktuell mit 11 x 7 x 9 mm. Kein wesentlicher Gelenkerguss. Fibroostose am Ligamentum patellae. Unauffällige Darstellung der miterfassten Muskulatur.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 64-year-old with progressive left knee pain related to "wear and tear". Evaluate for cartilage loss. Evaluate for meniscus tear.
Comparison: No recent left lower extremity imaging available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee is acquired in 3 anatomic planes at 1.2 Tesla using a local extremity receiver coil and a noncontrast protocol.

FINDINGS:

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Osseous and articular alignment at the left knee are normal.
No fracture. No focal osseous contusion.
No evidence for a recent pivot shift mechanism.

JOINT SPACE:
There is a small left knee effusion.
There is a minimal, partially ruptured Baker's cyst.
No intra-articular bodies.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a complex tear of the medial meniscus body and posterior horn with a dominant oblique undersurface component and a smaller inner margin radial component at the junction posterior horn and posterior root. There is moderate subsequent medial meniscus extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is diffuse partial-thickness cartilage loss all along the weightbearing region of the medial femoral condyle, with focal full-thickness cartilage loss at the medial femoral margin.
There is partial-thickness cartilage loss at the medial tibial margin.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: The lateral meniscus shows normal morphology and signal with no tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Articular cartilage throughout the lateral tibiofemoral compartment is normal.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
There is a small region of focal full-thickness cartilage loss at the patellar median ridge, with more diffuse partial-thickness cartilage loss extending along the medial patellar facet.
There is diffuse partial-thickness cartilage loss with deep chondral fissuring at the central femoral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal morphology and signal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): The MCL is bowed from medial meniscus extrusion, but intact.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: The fibular-collateral ligament and anterolateral ligament are normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Intact stabilizers.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Moderate degenerative hypertrophic distal quadriceps tendinopathy, with intrasubstance degeneration at its patellar attachment and mild enthesopathy. No high-grade quadriceps tear.
Patella tendon: Normal morphology and signal with no tear or degeneration.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No significant soft tissue edema in Hoffa's fat.
A TT-TG distance is normal at 7 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
The distal iliotibial band and biceps femoris are normal.
The distal semimembranosus is normal.

SOFT TISSUES:
Neurovascular structures in the popliteal fossa are normal.
Subcutaneous soft tissues are normal. No soft tissue mass.

IMPRESSION:

1. Extensive complex medial meniscus tear with a dominant oblique undersurface component at its body and posterior horn, moderate medial meniscus extrusion, and high-grade cartilage loss on the medial femoral condyle with low-grade cartilage loss at the medial tibial margin.

2. Focal full-thickness cartilage loss at the patellar median ridge with high-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss at the central femoral trochlea.

3. Moderate degenerative hypertrophic distal quadriceps tendinopathy, with mild enthesopathy.

4. Small left knee effusion with a minimal ruptured Baker's cyst.

SOFT TISSUES:

Subcutaneous soft tissues are normal. No soft tissue mass.

2. Focal full-thickness cartilage loss at the patellar median ridge with high-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss at the central femoral trochlea.

3. Moderate degenerative hypertrophic distal quadriceps tendinopathy, with mild enthesopathy.

reader_flags.reason: Direct surfacing oblique medial meniscal tear supports positive. Explicit_absence: unremarkable ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus and no popliteal cyst. Below_threshold: small effusion. Missing_evidence: no suspicious focal marrow signal alteration is qualified rather than an unqualified marrow/cortical-injury exclusion. Synovitis is unmentioned. The 12-mm measurement is a meniscal fragment, not cartilage loss.

Direct medial meniscal tear and tibial bone contusion support positives. Missing_evidence: partial ACL tear lacks high-grade fraction; effusion is ungraded; leaking Baker cyst lacks collection severity, and leak alone does not establish moderate/large. All remaining targets are absent from this brief report, including fracture.

Direct final medial meniscal tear and synovitis support positives; source also describes surfacing medial meniscal signal. Explicit_absence: normal ACL. Below_threshold: MCL alternatives are degeneration or grade-I injury, neither high-grade disruption. Missing_evidence: no strong evidence of lateral tear is qualified; global irregular cartilage thinning, worst medially/PF, and bare PF grade4 do not specify qualifying region size/depth mapping; effusion is ungraded; degenerative marrow edema/cysts do not establish contusion or acute fracture-line status. Explicit_absence: normal MCL. Below_threshold: ACL myxoid degeneration without disruption and lateral meniscal grade-II internal degeneration. Missing_evidence: bare medial meniscal gradeIII lacks a direct tear/surface description; medial and PF cartilage thinning (PF later called unnamed gradeII) lacks depth/extent; joint fluid is ungraded; marrow cyst and PF subchondral edema do not establish impact injury or acute fracture status. The 1-cm measurement belongs to a tibial cyst, not cartilage loss. Lateral cartilage, synovitis and Baker cyst are unmentioned; pes bursitis is not synovitis.

Direct surfacing/radial lateral meniscal tears support positive. Explicit_absence: normal collaterals and medial meniscus. Below_threshold: superficial medial and PF cartilage loss and mild fluid. Missing_evidence: ACL appears ruptured but complete/high-grade fiber fraction is not stated; lateral millimetric focal cartilage losses have neither explicit depth nor a clear measurement axis/qualifying area, so do not assume millimetric means extent; Baker cyst is ungraded; subchondral edema lacks impact causation and acute fracture assessment. Complete ACL and direct bucket-handle medial meniscal tears support positives. Direct complex medial meniscal tear and qualitative near-complete denudation of medial compartment articular cartilages support positives; the latter establishes broad regional extent as well as depth. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: preserved ACL, extrusion-related MCL distension/edema explicitly without rupture, isolated mild lateral meniscal signal, small effusion and no Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: lateral shallow fissures coexist with unquantified reduced thickness, so their depth does not settle the thinning; PF unnamed grades lack depth/extent; synovial hypertrophy alone lacks inflammation; medial degenerative marrow edema lacks impact etiology and acute fracture-line assessment. Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Irregularitäten des Knorpels femorotibial, teils höhergradig (Serie 5/ Image 19). Keine vollschichtige Läsion, kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Intakter Innenmeniskus mit allenfalls initialen mukoiden Veränderungen. Flüssigkeit angrenzend an das MCL (Serie 5/ Image 21).

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Geringe Irregularitäten des Knorpels am Patellafirst (Serie 4/ Image 10). Kein tiefgreifender Defekt, kein subchondrales Ödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Patellar- und Quadrizepssehne.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Deutlicher Gelenkerguss mit etwas verdickter Synovia. Regelrechtes flow-void in den erfassten Gelenken.

Missing_evidence: bare ACL tear lacks complete/high-grade fraction; global knee OA/unnamed grades3-4 lack compartment depth/extent; fluid and characteristic Baker cyst are ungraded; medial subchondral edema lacks impact cause; displaced posterior tibial fracture lacks explicit acute timing. Missing_evidence: PF defect depth is explicit but extent/delamination measurements are corrupted intact tokens; do not reconstruct decimals. Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: intact cruciates and no lateral meniscal tear associated with cyst. Missing_evidence: ACL partial tear lacks high-grade fraction; adjacent 12-mm cyst does not quantify tear; fluid ungraded; normal bone signal does not exclude cortical line. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/menisci/PF cartilage, no significant fluid or Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: state-after-complex medial rupture and questioned flap do not clearly establish current residual tear; medial denudation lacks specified loss extent; tiny osteochondral lateral lesion lacks a direct cartilage-loss assessment; numeric-only Baker lacks grade; degenerative marrow changes lack impact/acute-line assessment. Missing_evidence: medial thinning, marked lateral thinning and patellar fissuring lack specified depth/qualifying region extent; reactive marrow changes lack impact cause/acute line assessment. Fluid around loose bodies is not synovitis; synovitis unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL and preserved menisci/femorotibial-trochlear cartilage, no pathological popliteal cyst. Direct chronic complete ACL rupture, lateral meniscal tear and moderate fluid positive. Explicit_absence: normal MCL/medial meniscus/cartilage. Below_threshold: small Baker cyst. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: continuous heterogeneous ACL, preserved MCL/lateral meniscal outline and discrete medial meniscal degeneration. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus, normal femorotibial-trochlear cartilage and no popliteal cyst.
